source_instruction: i am looking fresh scent body lotion for dry skin.
query: I was out walking my golden retriever this morning and he stopped to roll in a whole patch of clover that was absolutely swarming with bumblebees, I froze so still I swear I didn’t breathe for a full minute waiting for him to get stung. When I got home I realized I left my favorite reusable iced coffee tumbler on the park bench, the one with the little hand-painted sunflowers on it my cousin got me for my birthday last year. I even stopped to ask the barista at the corner shop if anyone had turned it in, but no one had dropped it off yet. Anyway, can you help me find body care stuff for flaky sun-scorched skin that has that fresh vibe, for under $20?
